d:
Anant Singh Big Statement : bihar MLC chunav ke natijon ke bad patna men siyasi halchal tej hai. niraj kumar ki jit ke bad anant sinh ki pratikriya samne aaee hai. anant sinh ne kaha, “janta malik hai aur bhagvan hai...har-jit to hoti rahti hai.”
Chunav men har ke bad anant sinh ne kya kuchh kaha? niraj kumar ki jit aur anant sinh ke is bayan ke kya mayne hain? dekhie puri riporta.
Bihar ki rajniti, MLC chunav ke natijon aur netaon ke taja bayanon se juri har bari khabar ke lie hamare chainal se jure rahen.
